remembered.speaker: Mira
remembered.text: Still glad to be home, Iven? The gate has been less certain about you than we have.

oren.speaker: Oren
oren.text: Let him keep the answer he gave. Vierth remembers promises longer than people do.

remembered.speaker: Oren
remembered.text: You said there was nowhere else to go. Be careful. Vierth has begun taking words like invitations.

mira.speaker: Mira
mira.text: What he means is that you still have a place here. Even if the streets need reminding.

remembered.speaker: Oren
remembered.text: Whatever you came to settle, the Ash Well has been awake since you crossed the southern marker.

mira.speaker: Mira
mira.text: And Oren has been practising that warning since breakfast. Go carefully, Iven.

oren_deja_vu.speaker: Oren
oren_deja_vu.text: You took the southern road again. I could have sworn I watched you arrive before dawn.

mira_dreams.speaker: Mira
mira_dreams.text: Don't start with that. Half the town is dreaming things that never happened.

return_question.speaker: Oren
return_question.text: Then tell me something simpler, Iven. Why did you come back?

choices.text: I had nowhere else to go.

missed_oren.speaker: Oren
missed_oren.text: Then remember it as it was. The town may ask you to prove that memory.

missed_mira.speaker: Mira
missed_mira.text: Or you could simply let him through before the gate starts giving advice too.

nowhere_mira.speaker: Mira
nowhere_mira.text: Vierth is still allowed to be home, even when it is the last place left.

nowhere_oren.speaker: Oren
nowhere_oren.text: Provided the town agrees it has room for all the versions of you.

business_mira.speaker: Mira
business_mira.text: Oren. If he wanted the whole gate to know, he would have brought a bell.

oren_road.speaker: Oren
oren_road.text: You took the southern road? It hasn't held steady since dawn.

mira_welcome.speaker: Mira
mira_welcome.text: Leave the courier alone, Oren. He looks like the road already questioned him.

return_question.speaker: Oren
return_question.text: Three years away. Why come back now?

choices.text: I had nowhere else to go.

missed_oren.speaker: Oren
missed_oren.text: Then hold on to the Vierth you missed. This one has been forgetting itself.

missed_mira.speaker: Mira
missed_mira.text: Welcome home, Iven. Even if the town takes a moment to remember you.

nowhere_mira.speaker: Mira
nowhere_mira.text: Then you chose well enough. A last refuge can still become a home.

nowhere_oren.speaker: Oren
nowhere_oren.text: Assuming the southern road stays where you left it.

business_oren.speaker: Oren
business_oren.text: People who say that usually mean the Well.

business_mira.speaker: Mira
business_mira.text: You do not owe the gate your reasons. But whatever waits inside already knows you are here.
